physical_source_meaning: Cooling state actually driven at the edge, not an ACK and not electrical proof.
origin: POWER_PATH controller applied state as present in the telemetry row
quality_requirement: applied state present at the anchor
available_at_prediction_time: applied state observed at or before t
missingness_behavior: missing when the applied state is absent
online_real_availability: NOT_ESTABLISHED_FOR_PREDICTIVE_USE: zero predictive-eligible real runs and no qualified real electrical development population
leakage_or_shortcut_risk: CONTROLLER_ACTION_PROXY: the controller may already have reacted to the same thermal excursion; a classifier can recognize an intervention instead of predicting the event
intended_role: predictive input candidate and applied-state observability
verified_actuation: NO: an applied command is not proof that current flowed

physical_source_meaning: Edge-applied PWM duty ratio at the anchor.
origin: POWER_PATH controller applied duty as present in the telemetry row
quality_requirement: applied duty present at the anchor
available_at_prediction_time: duty observed at or before t
missingness_behavior: missing when duty is absent; a missing duty is never zero
online_real_availability: NOT_ESTABLISHED_FOR_PREDICTIVE_USE: zero predictive-eligible real runs and no qualified real electrical development population
leakage_or_shortcut_risk: CONTROLLER_ACTION_PROXY: duty is chosen by the controller/policy and may encode the intervention policy rather than plant state
intended_role: predictive input candidate and applied-state observability
verified_actuation: NO: duty is an applied setting, not a measured response

physical_source_meaning: Elapsed time since the last observed change of the (applied_cooling, applied_duty) pair in the same boot.
origin: past-only elapsed time since the last observed applied (state, duty) change
quality_requirement: both applied state and duty present at the change and at the anchor
available_at_prediction_time: change observed at or before t
lookback_rule: since last observed applied change, same boot only
missingness_behavior: missing when no applied change has been observed in this boot or the current state is absent
online_real_availability: NOT_ESTABLISHED_FOR_PREDICTIVE_USE: zero predictive-eligible real runs and no qualified real electrical development population
leakage_or_shortcut_risk: CONTROLLER_ACTION_PROXY: a recent transition is a controller event; the feature is causal at t but not a plant-state measurement
intended_role: predictive input candidate and intervention-recency diagnostic
verified_actuation: NO: an observed transition is not verified cooling

physical_source_meaning: PZEM cooling-branch voltage; never a total-system quantity.
origin: PZEM-017 cooling-branch voltage (branch observation, not whole-device power)
quality_requirement: electrical quality VALID at the anchor
available_at_prediction_time: value observed at or before t
missingness_behavior: missing unless electrical quality is VALID; numeric UNKNOWN values are never promoted
online_real_availability: NOT_ESTABLISHED_FOR_PREDICTIVE_USE: zero predictive-eligible real runs and no qualified real electrical development population
leakage_or_shortcut_risk: DOWNSTREAM_RESPONSE: voltage is a branch response that may follow the controller action rather than precede the thermal event
intended_role: electrical response observability and predictive candidate
verified_actuation: NO: electrical observation only; voltage does not verify actuation or thermal response

physical_source_meaning: PZEM cooling-branch current; never a total-system quantity.
origin: PZEM-017 cooling-branch current through the branch shunt
quality_requirement: electrical quality VALID at the anchor
available_at_prediction_time: value observed at or before t
missingness_behavior: missing unless electrical quality is VALID
online_real_availability: NOT_ESTABLISHED_FOR_PREDICTIVE_USE: zero predictive-eligible real runs and no qualified real electrical development population
leakage_or_shortcut_risk: DOWNSTREAM_RESPONSE: current is a response to the applied command; it is not proof of successful thermal cooling
intended_role: electrical response observability and predictive candidate
verified_actuation: NO: electrical observation only; current is not proof of thermal cooling

physical_source_meaning: PZEM cooling-branch power; not whole-system energy.
origin: PZEM-017 cooling-branch power (voltage x current x meter convention)
quality_requirement: electrical quality VALID at the anchor
available_at_prediction_time: value observed at or before t
missingness_behavior: missing unless electrical quality is VALID; absent PZEM is not zero
online_real_availability: NOT_ESTABLISHED_FOR_PREDICTIVE_USE: zero predictive-eligible real runs and no qualified real electrical development population
leakage_or_shortcut_risk: DOWNSTREAM_RESPONSE + PWM_SAMPLING: sampled power on a PWM branch is a meter-dependent observation; branch power is not whole-system energy
intended_role: electrical response observability and predictive candidate
verified_actuation: NO: electrical observation only; power is not proof of thermal response

physical_source_meaning: Cooling-branch PZEM energy register value; reset/rollover is reported as missing, never silently integrated.
origin: PZEM-017 cooling-branch energy register value with reset refusal
quality_requirement: electrical quality VALID and non-decreasing counter within the boot
available_at_prediction_time: counter observed at or before t
missingness_behavior: missing unless VALID and not below the previous VALID counter in the same boot
online_real_availability: NOT_ESTABLISHED_FOR_PREDICTIVE_USE: zero predictive-eligible real runs and no qualified real electrical development population
leakage_or_shortcut_risk: RUN_AGE_OR_SCENARIO_IDENTIFIER: a cumulative counter grows with time and can act as a run-age/scenario shortcut; a reset or rollover must never be read as negative consumption
intended_role: diagnostic energy provenance; predictive candidate only with caution
verified_actuation: NO: an energy register is not a thermal-response proof

physical_source_meaning: Left-rectangle integral of VALID cooling-branch power since the first VALID electrical sample of the boot.
origin: past-only left-rectangle integral of VALID cooling-branch power
quality_requirement: every interval since integration start is VALID with a gap no longer than max_gap_s
available_at_prediction_time: all power samples from integration start through t
lookback_rule: since first VALID electrical sample, same boot only
missingness_behavior: missing when any contributing interval is non-VALID or longer than max_gap_s; never bridged
online_real_availability: NOT_ESTABLISHED_FOR_PREDICTIVE_USE: zero predictive-eligible real runs and no qualified real electrical development population
leakage_or_shortcut_risk: RUN_AGE_OR_SCENARIO_IDENTIFIER + DOWNSTREAM_RESPONSE: cumulative energy grows with elapsed run time and integrates the controller response
intended_role: diagnostic energy provenance; predictive candidate only with caution
verified_actuation: NO: integrated branch energy is not verified cooling
